# Jonathan Emmanuel

> Freelance AI UGC and product ad creative based in Lagos, Nigeria. Makes AI generated UGC avatar ads and product commercials for DTC and ecommerce brands running paid social on Meta, TikTok and YouTube.

## Summary
- Name: Jonathan Emmanuel
- Role: AI UGC avatar ads and product commercials
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria (West Africa Time, GMT+1). Works remotely worldwide.
- Contact: WhatsApp +234 904 294 9057, email jonathanemma108@gmail.com
- Rate: from $17 per hour, fixed price per deliverable on request
- Response time: 0 to 4 hours
- Languages: English, Yoruba

## Services
- UGC avatar ads: avatar led hooks written for the first three seconds, multiple script and avatar variations, exported 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5.
- Product commercials: cinematic product film with the product spec locked before generation so the product stays identical across scenes.
- Short form social video: Reels, TikToks and Shorts on a weekly delivery schedule.
- Voiceover and audio: multi language and multi accent reads, mixed to the pacing of the edit.
- Editing and finishing: assembly, pacing, captions, grade, platform safe exports.
- Ad deconstruction: breaking a reference ad into pacing, shot types, cut rhythm and hook structure, then rebuilding it around a different product.

## Tools
Kling, Runway, Veo 3, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, CapCut. Chosen per shot rather than defaulting to one model.

## Selected work
- AETHER: 38 second cinematic beverage commercial.
- STRYDE: one product built as two ad formats for A/B testing.
- Compact action camera: UGC unboxing ad cut for TikTok and Meta.

## Credentials
- Digital Advertising Certification, HubSpot Academy.
- Studying Computer Science (BS), Lagos State University.

## Hiring
Direct by WhatsApp or email, or through Upwork and Fiverr. Clients own the finished ads outright once paid. NDAs available on request.
